comment: Release pins for the published Rust dashboard EXE (installer ticket 13). The EXE itself is deliberately untracked (see .gitignore: releases/rust/* is a build artifact rebuilt by `cargo tauri build`), so its identity lives here instead. tests/sandbox-test-suite.ps1 §T13 reads this file — after a rebuild, update the size/hash here and nowhere else.
